    right_span = sandbox.add_beam(x=span_right, y=deck_cy, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=density)
    
    # Central beam (pivot point)
    central_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=deck_cy, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=density)

    support_beam2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.0, y=deck_cy, width=0.5, height=deck_h, density=density)
    
    # Connect left_span to central_beam with a rigid joint
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, central_beam, (span_left, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect right_span to central_beam with a pivot joint
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, central_beam, (span_right, deck_cy), type='pivot')
    
    # Connect support beams to central_beam with rigid joints
    sandbox.add_joint(support_beam1, central_beam, (8.0, deck_cy), type='rigid')

    central_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=10.0, y=deck_cy, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=beam_density)
    support_beam1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=8.0, y=deck_cy, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=beam_density)
    support_beam2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=12.0, y=deck_cy, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=beam_density)
    
    # Joints: pivot at left and right spans (allow rotation), rigid elsewhere
    # Left span to ground (pivot)
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, None, (span_left, deck_cy), type='pivot')
    # Right span to ground (pivot)
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, None, (span_right, deck_cy), type='pivot')
    # Left span to central beam
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, central_beam, (span_left, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    # Right span to central beam
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, central_beam, (span_right, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    # Support beams to central beam
    sandbox.add_joint(support_beam1, central_beam, (8.0, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(support_beam2, central_beam, (12.0, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    
    return left_span
